notes: Maps the car's own numbers: Tesla page gains a Car attributes section that finds every numeric attribute and NumberValue on the vehicle that decides how it moves - max speed, top speed, acceleration, thrust, torque, gravity, mass, grip, friction, drag, boost, nitro - and shows it under a readable name (Max speed, Gravity, Nitro multiplier) with the mapped value in an editable box and a Reset next to it. Values live in Text, never a placeholder. Every write is read back: a number the server keeps re-sending is reported as server-owned instead of silently snapping. workspace.Gravity is included for the flying car.
